items.title: Bitcoin rebounds past $80,000 as markets shrug off midterms and Binance hack

items.title: Strategy's STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks
items.summary: Strategy's STRC preferred hit $100 par on Wednesday for the first time since May, after billions in buybacks, a 12% dividend rate and a switch to daily payouts. This post Strategy's STRC Hits $100 Par for First Time Since May After Over $2 Billion in Buybacks first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .

items.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
items.summary: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto's exposure to shifting US political power.
